The three headers that need glog / Eigen / Boost / FreeImage are replaced by include shims in common/colmap/: util/logging.h (LOG, THROW_CHECK*, CHECK* macros), util/endian.h (two undefined template declarations named only by GpuMat::Read/Write), sensor/bitmap.h (a Bitmap with RowMajorData()). The host class PatchMatchCuda in the .cu is compiled but not used (needs Image/Bitmap I/O); common/driver.cu performs the same initialisation steps (InitRefImage with the real GpuMatRefImage::Filter, InitSourceImages, InitTransforms for rotation 0, InitWorkspaceMemory with the real GpuMatPRNG) and launches the real kernels as RunWithWindowSizeAndStep does. Flags: the project's (CMake Release -O3 -DNDEBUG, CMAKE_CUDA_STANDARD 17, --expt-relaxed-constexpr, -Wno-deprecated-gpu-targets, -fPIC) with -arch=sm_89, -lineinfo, never -G. The .cu's dispatcher instantiates the kernels for every window radius 1..20 x step 1,2 and four Sweep variants (210 kernels, 46 MB cubin), as the project build does; build time about 80 s.
driver: common/driver.cu: ComputeInitialCost<7,1><<<ceil(W/32), 32>>> then SweepFromTopToBottom<7,1,false,false,false><<<ceil(W/32), 32>>> (the first sweep of iteration 0, rotation 0), window radius 3, step 1, geom_consistency off, num_samples 5; args W H NS default 32 32 2. Host check: depth, normal and cost maps finite (nonfinite_or_out_of_range=0 expected).
input: W=32 x H=32 reference image (smooth texture), NS=2 source images (reference shifted by 3 and 6 px), pure-translation poses (0.1*(i+1), 0, 0), fx=fy=40, depth range [1,3], sigma_spatial 3, sigma_color 0.2. One 32-thread block, all lanes in range; 'driver 28' makes 4 lanes take the early 'continue' at L1008 while the others are still in Compute (the oracle's second pattern).
access_estimate: about 1.5e6 thread-level shared+global accesses (ComputeInitialCost about 1.5e5: per thread and row 39 shared shift/fill accesses + 2 x 50 window reads + 8 global; Sweep about 1.3e6: about 22 Compute calls x 50 window reads per thread and row + about 100 other; 1024 thread-rows each); texture fetches not counted.
kernels_in_sm89_sass: cuobjdump -sass: ComputeInitialCost<7, 1>(GpuMatView<float> x3, unsigned long long, GpuMatView<float> x2, unsigned long long x2, float, float) and SweepFromTopToBottom<7,1,false,false,false>(...) (plus <7,1,true,false,false>, <7,1,false,true,false>, <7,1,true,true,true>) present in driver.sm_89.cubin, 210 kernels in total. The window accesses lower to STS/LDS (shared address space is tracked through LocalRefImage::data; ComputeInitialCost<7,1> has 68 STS/LDS instructions and no generic ST/LD).
